messages:
Maya (CS): Hey team — Apogee Health reached out requesting a private deployment of a domain-trained summarizer for clinical visit notes. They need PHI handling, HSM-backed key management, and a fast go-live (~3 weeks). Asking for intake: model artifact format, safety eval plan, and any blockers.
Liam (AE): Thanks Maya. I had a sync with their engineering lead yesterday. Their model is a fine-tuned 7B Flan variant saved as `apogee-summarizer-v1.tar.gz` and they want us to host in their VPC. They're also asking about token pricing and whether dedicated capacity is required for SLA.
Rohit (ML Eng): Quick read: 7B Flan variant should run on our private stack w/ 2x A10 or 1x A100 depending on perf targets. Need to know quantization tolerance (8-bit vs 4-bit). Any bench data on latency @ 512 tokens?
Maya (CS): No perf numbers from them yet. I asked for a sample payload and 100 example notes. They flagged that some notes contain embedded PHI (SSNs masked but names retained).
Sophie (Security): PHI + private deployment — we need an HSM/KMS integration and audit logging enabled. Also confirm whether training data contains any third-party PII that would change our DPA clauses. ETA on model artifacts + eval set?
Liam (AE): I'll push for artifacts and a redacted eval set today. Also flagged renewal risk — sales says this account is on a Q3 enterprise renewal and this integration influences expansion. If onboarding slips beyond 3 weeks, they may pause commit.
Rohit (ML Eng): For the safety eval plan I suggest:
```
- run entity redaction and extraction check (PHI leakage)
- hallucination/regression tests on 200 prompts
- ROUGE/COMET-style quality on gold summaries
- latency p50/p95 at batch sizes 1 and 8
```
I can spin up an eval harness if we get the 100 examples.
Maya (CS): Awesome — customer ok with us using synthetic redaction for initial evals. I'll upload their sample set to the secure bucket and share link (will be redacted first).
Enablement Bot: Ticket CS-#4827 created, assigned to Rohit and Sophie. Slack thread linked: https://redwood.internal/cs/tickets/4827
Sophie (Security): I'll need their DLP policy and confirmation that logs are accessible to them but stored encrypted at rest. Also request that they sign updated BAA addendum for PHI.
Liam (AE): Copying legal, but we can fast-track the BAA. Also confirming pricing: if they want 99th pct SLA and dedicated nodes, we should propose Redwood Dedicated monthly commit; I'll draft numbers.
Rohit (ML Eng): Blocker checklist from infra side: model artifact must include tokenizer files, a reproducible config (model_size, vocab_size), and guidance on kv-cache format. If they used custom layers, we may need an ops patch.
Maya (CS): I scheduled a 30-min tech enablement call for Monday 10am PT with Apogee eng + our platform + security. Can everyone join?
Rohit (ML Eng): I can join.
Sophie (Security): I'll join the first 15 minutes for BAA/DLP items.
Liam (AE): I'll join to own the contract/pricing bits.
Maya (CS): Perfect. Next steps: 1) Liam to secure artifact + redacted eval set (today) 2) Sophie to confirm BAA checklist (EOD) 3) Rohit to prepare eval harness + perf baseline (48h after artifacts) 4) CS to flag renewal risk if timeline slips >3 weeks.
Liam (AE): Noted. I'll push artifacts and aim for the EOD delivery.
Maya (CS): Thanks — I'll post the secure link here when uploaded. :thumbsup:
